items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: Mangan was playing soccer with us then. Mangan could play any kind of blowing... Sometimes he'd put corn it with us. Two sharpies together.

ctx.x: She was playing piano down there. And then Monty Minelli, you know, when Monty Minelli was playing with that guy? Oh, yeah, sure. Yeah, we used to play out there for Captain Powell. That's right. That was a regular job we had out there. I remember one time. The first thing was on then, you know? Used to get plenty of homeboys and the lightning there, you know? You know, let's go ahead. He could go anyway with Captain Powell, man. I remember one time we went out to play out about the Art of Untyrone. Oh, yeah,…
Ask him, did he ever make any records?
